frames.frame: It is [Adj] / It has been [V-ed] that [S V]
frames.gloss: 据估计/据推测……（外置主语从句：it 占位，真正主语是 that 从句）
frames.pattern_notes: 教材清单已有 It be[adj] to[V] 外置，此处是其 that 从句新变体。固定骨架：It + be/has been + 形容词或被动分词 + that + 完整从句（陈述语序）。学习者常误把 it 当指代前文名词、或把 that 后从句当定语，导致读慢。

examples.s: In the face of the frequent and often vivid media coverage, it is likely that children will have formed ideas about rainforests – what and where they are, why they are important, what endangers them – independent of any formal tuition.
It is also possible that some of these ideas will be mistaken.
It has been speculated that, as the blowholes evolved and migrated to the top of the head, the neural pathways serving sense of smell may have been nearly all sacrificed.

Visual Symbols and the Blind From a number of recent studies, it has become clear that blind people can appreciate the use of outlines and perspectives to describe the arrangement of objects and other surfaces in space.

frames.frame: the [抽象名词: estimate/misconception/information/fact] that [S V]
frames.gloss: ……这一估计/误解/说法（that 从句作同位语，说明前面的抽象名词内容）
frames.pattern_notes: 清单中「同位语插入」指 NP 同位语；这是 that 从句型同位语，属新类型。抽象名词 + that + 陈述句，that 是连词不是关系代词，从句内主谓齐全。学习者极易把 that 当关系代词去找先行词缺位，是最经典的误读点。

examples.s: For example, one graphic illustration to which children might readily relate is the estimate that rainforests are being destroyed at a rate equivalent to one thousand football fields every forty minutes – about the duration of a normal classroom period.

While two fifths of the students provided the information that the rainforests provide oxygen, in some cases this response also embraced the misconception that rainforest destruction would reduce atmospheric oxygen, making the atmosphere incompatible with human life on Earth.

frames.frame: The [N], [V-ed 分词插入], was that [S V]
frames.gloss: （调查中）某观点/误解是……（名词作主语 + 表语 that 从句，常夹分词插入语）
frames.pattern_notes: 与假分裂 What[A] is that[B] 不同：主语是普通名词而非 what 从句。骨架为 NP + (分词短语插入) + be + that + 从句。I00031 与 I00038 结构几乎完全平行（NP + V-ed by 百分比 + was that），整存整取优势明显。

examples.s: The dominant idea, raised by 64% of the pupils, was that rainforests provide animals with habitats.
One misconception, expressed by some 1) % of the pupils, was that acid rain is responsible for rainforest destruction; a similar proportion said that pollution is destroying rainforests.
One encouragement is that the results of similar studies about other environmental issues suggest that older children seem to acquire the ability to appreciate value and evaluate conflicting views.

frames.frame: The [第N] question / Responses to question [N] concerned [X]
frames.gloss: 第 N 个问题涉及/考察……（研究报告问卷句式）
frames.pattern_notes: concerned 是过去式谓语动词（涉及），不是形容词「有关的」。固定语序：问题编号 + concerned + 话题 NP。本篇研究报道中三次复现（I00027/I00030/I00035），学习者常误读为「被关心的」从而解错句意。

examples.s: The second question concerned the geographical location of rainforests.
Responses to question three concerned the importance of rainforests.
The fourth question concerned the causes of the destruction of rainforests.

frames.gloss: （据观察）似乎/看来……（认识情态缓和语）
frames.pattern_notes: 与已报的 tend to[V]、be likely to 同一家族的认知缓和框架，但 seem/appear 版未在清单。不定式可带完成体（appear to have deteriorated）。注意 I03496 中出现在 which 引导的关系从句内。

examples.s: Baleen species, on the other hand, appear to have some related brain structures but it is not known whether these are functional.

The South American boutu and Chinese beiji, for instance, appear to have very limited vision, and the Indian susus are blind, their eyes reduced to slits that probably allow them to sense only the direction and intensity of light.

Although the senses of taste and smell appear to have deteriorated, and vision in water appears to be uncertain, such weaknesses are more than compensated for by cetaceans’ well-developed acoustic sense.
Atlit-Yam was a village on the coast of the eastern Mediterranean, which seems to have been thriving until around 7,000 BC.

frames.gloss: ……，而与此同时/相比之下……（句尾对比性 while 从句）
frames.pattern_notes: 清单中「While让步, 主句」指前置让步；此为后置对比新变体：while 从句挂在主句之后表对照（非时间、非让步）。学习者易把句尾 while 读成「当……时候」，把对比关系误读为时间关系。I03532 与 I03592 均为主句 + 逗号 + while + 对比句。

examples.s: In many cases it's only these containers that remain, while the wooden ships have been buried under silt on the seabed.

Birds and animals can die gruesome deaths through being trapped or caught up in plastic bags or ropes, while the long process required for these plastics to decay means that they remain a threat for many years to come.

frames.gloss: ……的证据是（某物）正在做某事／由（某人）做某事而实现（带主语的动名词复合结构）
frames.pattern_notes: 介词后不接纯动名词而接「名词主语 + V-ing」：evidence of sea creatures ingesting...、by children absorbing...。学习者常把 of/by 后的 NP 当介词宾语读完，再被后面的 -ing 悬挂卡住；与「with+O+补语」同属复合结构家族但介词不同、未被清单覆盖。

examples.s: Worse, there is now beginning to be evidenee of sea creatures ingesting smaller globules of disintegrating plastic, which harms them and all the other creatures in their particular food chain.
These ideas may be developed by children absorbing ideas through the popular media.

frames.gloss: ……（发生/发展的）那个场所/领域（名词后介词+which 限制性关系从句）
frames.pattern_notes: 清单有「the way(that/in which)」与「动词+介词+wh-从句」，均未覆盖普通名词后 in which 的定语从句。固定语序：先行名词 + in which + 完整主谓。in which 是高误读点（被拆成 in + which 指代混乱）。

examples.s: Environmental education offers an arena in which these sills can be developed, which is essential fore these children as future decision –makers.
Such variation can no doubt be explained with reference to the habitats in which individual species have developed.

frames.gloss: 对/为 A 而言比 B 更……（比较级后介词短语的平行省略）
frames.pattern_notes: more ... than 后第二个介词短语省略了重复的中心词：more useful to A than to B、more the subject of A than of B。学习者常在 than 后找不到比较对象而读慢，或误把 than 后成分当新句子。判据2强：平行省略必须整存整取地识别。

examples.s: For example, vision is obviously more useful to species inhabiting clear open waters than to those living in turbid rivers and flooded plains.

Some of the more complicated sounds are clearly communicative, although what role they may play in the social life and ‘culture’ of cetaceans has been more the subject of wild speculation than of solid science.

candidates.s: STEPHANIE： Yeah, but whereas something like The Happy Prince just carried me along with it, The Lord of the Rings took more effort than I was prepared to give it.
candidates.note: whereas 前置对比从句（Whereas [A], [B]），While 让步的对比变体；仅 1 例，未达 2 例门槛。

candidates.s: Whatever the cause, it now lies ten metres below the surface of the Mediterranean, buried under sand at the bottom of the sea.
candidates.note: Whatever the [N], [主句]：无动词让步从句，误读判据极强（Whatever 后缺谓语），但仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Creating an internet in the sea for AUVs to communicate is no easy matter.
candidates.note: [V-ing 主语] is no easy matter：表语 no+抽象名词框架，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: For a fuller picture, researchers need more sunken settlements, but the hard part is finding them.
candidates.note: the hard part is [V-ing]：动名词表语，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: However, the position of the eyes so restricts the field of vision in baleen whales that they pro- bably do not have stereoscopic vision.
candidates.note: so + 动词 + 宾语 + that 从句（so...that 的动词修饰变体，so 提前至谓语动词前），误读判据极强，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Evidently, however, the blind not only figured out meanings for each line of motion, but as a group they gene- rally came up with the same meaning at least as frequently as did sighted subjects.
candidates.note: as [副词] as did [S]：比较 as 从句末助动词倒装（as did sighted subjects），误读判据强，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Judging from the way it watches and tracks airborne flying fish, it can apparently see fairly well through the air–water interface as well.
candidates.note: Judging from [X], [主句]：悬垂评注分词开头，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: This is surprising considering the high level of media coverage on this issue.
candidates.note: [This is Adj] considering [NP]：considering 后置作介词（非分词），误读判据强，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: What is more, the consensus among the sighted was bare- ly higher than that among the blind.
candidates.note: higher than that among [NP]：指示代词 that + 介词短语替代比较对象，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: (See Fig. 2) When we tested four totally blind volun- teers using the same list, we found that their choices closely resembled those made by the sighted subjects.
candidates.note: those [V-ed] by [NP]：those+过去分词缩略关系从句（those made by the sighted subjects），仅 1 例。

candidates.s: All but one of the blind subjects assigned distinctive motions to each wheel.
candidates.note: All but one of [NP] + 谓语：all but 取「除……外全部」量词义，学习者误读 but 为连词，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Thus, we concluded that the blind interpret abstract shapes as sighted people do.
candidates.note: interpret [A] as [S] do：as-方式从句用 do 替代（as sighted people do），仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Eye position in freshwater dolphins, which often swim on their side or upside down while feeding, suggests that what vision they have is stereoscopic forward and upward.
candidates.note: what vision they have is [C]：what+名词部分自由关系从句作主语（what vision they have），误读判据极强，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: However, whether saving individual species should be the main focus of environmental protection is debatable.
candidates.note: whether [S V] is [Adj]：whether 主语从句前置不外置，误读判据强，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Despite the extensive coverage in the popular media of the destruction of rainforests, little formal information is available about children’s ideas in this area, the aim of the present study is to start to provide such information, to help teachers design their educational strategies to build upon correct ideas and to displace misconceptions and to plan programs in environmental studies in their schools.
candidates.note: Despite [NP], [主句]：另有 I03620 同构共 2 例，但 Despite+名词是基础语法点，误读判据弱，不入 A 类。

candidates.s: Habitable areas are gradually shrinking, often for some of the poorest groups of people, but there seems to be little obvious action taking place.
candidates.note: there seems to be [NP]：there be 与 seem 的套接，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Worse, there is now beginning to be evidenee of sea creatures ingesting smaller globules of disintegrating plastic, which harms them and all the other creatures in their particular food chain.
candidates.note: Worse, [S V]：评注性 Worse 置于句首作连接性状语，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: The evidenee of climate change is there for us all to see: rising sea levels and associated flooding with the loss of homes at low land levels are becoming more frequent.
candidates.note: [NP] is there for [O] to [V]：is there for us all to see，习语性框架，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: The glasshouse has gone and in its places is a water feature; similarly, where the pond for water plants stood there is now a children's play area with a cafe nearby.
candidates.note: where [S V], there is now [NP]：地点 where 从句 + there 存现句（where the pond stood there is now...），误读判据强，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: In today's class rm going to talk about marine archaeology, the branch of archaeology focusing on human interaction with the sea, lakes and rivers.
candidates.note: 讲座开场定义式 I'm going to talk about [X], [同位语定义]（口语语域），仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Underwater research used to require divers to find shipwrecks or artefacts, but in the second half of the twentieth century, various types of underwater vehicles were developed, some controlled from a ship on the surface, and some of them autonomous, which means they don't need to be operated by a person.
candidates.note: some [V-ed]..., and some (of them) [Adj]：Some..., others... 的无动词省略变体，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: When it sank, it was carrying medical goods, in wooden or tin receptacles.
candidates.note: are thought to have been [V-ed]：被动+完成不定式双重被动（thought to have been dissolved），误读判据强，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Creating an internet in the sea for AUVs to communicate is no easy matter.
candidates.note: for [NP] to [V] 目的不定式后置（for AUVs to communicate；另有 I03614 for people to smell）：2 例，但属纯语法范畴，骨架判据拿不准。

candidates.s: Although the senses of taste and smell appear to have deteriorated, and vision in water appears to be uncertain, such weaknesses are more than compensated for by cetaceans’ well-developed acoustic sense.
candidates.note: be more than [V-ed] by [X]：more than 修饰被动谓语（more than compensated for by），误读判据强，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: These misconceptions do not remain isolated but become incorporated into a multifaceted, but organized, conceptual framework, making it and the component ideas, some of which are erroneous, more robust but also accessible to modification.
candidates.note: [NP], some of which [S V],：of-which 型非限定关系从句插入，仅 1 例。

candidates.s: All our subjects deemed the circle soft and the square hard.
candidates.note: deem [O] [C]：宾补动词带并列补语（deemed the circle soft and the square hard），仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Its been described as the largest and best preserved prehistoric settlement ever found on the seabed.
candidates.note: the [最高级] [N] ever [V-ed]：superlative+ever+过去分词后置修饰（the largest ... ever found），仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Birds and animals can die gruesome deaths through being trapped or caught up in plastic bags or ropes, while the long process required for these plastics to decay means that they remain a threat for many years to come.
candidates.note: through being [V-ed]：被动动名词原因状语（through being trapped），by V-ing 的介词变体，骨架判据拿不准。
